stem.text: A bungee jumper jumps from a platform and is decelerated by an elastic bungee cord, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram before jumping: a jumper standing on a platform above a ground line, with a bungee cord attached to the platform. Labels: platform, bungee jumper, bungee cord, ground, before jumping.
Diagram during the jump: a jumper hanging below a platform on a long bungee cord, above a ground line. Labels: platform, bungee cord, ground, during the jump.

stem.text: When the jumper makes the jump, his initial gravitational potential energy is converted into his kinetic energy and into elastic potential energy in the cord.
At which part of the jump are all three types of energy non-zero?

A.text: on the platform before the jump

B.text: on the way down before the cord has started to extend

C.text: on the way down as he decelerates

D.text: at the bottom of the jump when he is stationary
